FixtureQuery: SELECT a.id,a.status,a.version,a.capacity,a.registered_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration r WHERE r.activity_id=a.id AND r.status='CONFIRMED') AS confirmed,a.capacity-a.registered_count AS remaining,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration r WHERE r.activity_id=a.id) AS records FROM activity a WHERE a.created_at>='2026-10-23 08:59:36' ORDER BY a.id;
